Simon Willison quotes Jack Despain Zhou describing a sense of de-individualization as similar AI-sounding prose appears across videos, conference talks and professional pitches. The excerpt captures a cultural complaint about homogenized expression.

A collected quotation is neither a representative survey nor proof that the particular texts the speaker encountered were generated by Claude. Perceived style and verified authorship remain different questions. The excerpt supplies no measured prevalence, controlled comparison or demonstrated effect on readers.
highlights: Concern is loss of individual voice
Claude attribution reflects the speaker's perception
No population estimate or causal study is established
